originating_constraint: Preserve current greedy output and hybrid state while improving committed throughput through the real API.
downward_contract: Complete normalized prompt hidden and shifted draft KV before speculation; complete accepted target prefix including full logits before publication.
composition_point: Batched cancellable draft Prefill + weight-reusing multi-row target verifier + isolated service controller; then P65 sanity and P8192/P40000 O256 for draft lengths 2/3.

implementation.prompt_handoff: Ordinary corrected whole-core engine O1 generation, then independent per-row existing final norm into preallocated BF16 capture; initialize draft t from hidden[t], prompt[t+1] for 0<=t<P-1.
implementation.prompt_target_invariants: Persistent Conv/GDN/K/V and first-token full logits unchanged; captured last hidden bitwise equals ordinary whole-core final hidden.
implementation.transaction: Legacy or whole-core exact owner, SM87 quantized lm-head; restore Conv/GDN, normalized hidden and all 248320 BF16 logits for each accepted prefix; append-only target KV.
implementation.allocation: Construction-only, each allocation retains 8 GiB device free; no round or initialization allocation.
implementation.engine_access: Private borrowed owner access compiled only with internal test seams; no installed layout change or public selector.

device_validation.model_authentication: Existing full pinned base shard authentication plus separate same-byte MTP shard3 authentication; identities in predecessor device record.
device_validation.oracle: Each case independently repeats corrected whole-core Prefill, then scalar teacher-forced target steps and target-conditioned draft replay. Never compares current Prefill against Legacy scalar Prefill as model truth.
